logp.method_description: The logP values for compounds 1b–c, 5a, 6a and 7a were obtained by using the shake-flask method and UV-vis spectroscopy.32 Stock solutions of the complexes were prepared in a pre-mixed mixture of water/PBS with octanol 50/50 v/v (total concentrations 5 × 10-4 M). The resultant solutions were shaken for 72 h and then equilibrated for 24 h. The concentrations of the complexes in the organic and aqueous phases were then determined using UV absorbance spectroscopy. log P was defined as the logarithm of the ratio of the concentrations of the complex in the organic and aqueous phases (log P = log{[complex(octanol)]/[complex(water)]}).
